# Discover Walks

> > Discover Walks offers guided walking tours and local experiences across major cities including Paris, London, Barcelona, and San Francisco, led by native local guides.

Discover Walks provides both free and paid walking tours focusing on authentic local experiences. The company specializes in cultural and historical tours across Europe and select cities worldwide, featuring iconic landmarks like the Pantheon, Latin Quarter, and Luxembourg Garden in Paris.

## Key Topics

- Paris walking tours
- Latin Quarter
- Pantheon Paris
- Luxembourg Garden

- Local guides

- European city tours
- Cultural attractions
